task: Extend the project-scoped activity trail with an event taxonomy catalogue (label+category), category filtering, entity-label snapshotting, a dedicated member-spend-enforcement event, a project-scoped metadata endpoint, and explicit disabled-vs-empty recording-state reporting.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches a new taxonomy catalogue module (new abstraction), ActivityEvent model, activity_repository (category filter, distinct-event-types-in-project query, disabled-vs-empty), activity_event_service (new metadata method), the project activity events router (new endpoint + extended filter), and project_service.py::update_project (cross-domain conditional emission via SettingsService) — 4+ components across 3-4 layers plus a genuinely new abstraction (the catalogue).

Core behaviors are enumerated clearly, but the exact label-column shape, per-emit-site label resolution across up to 36 call sites, and the response-envelope shape for the disabled-vs-empty distinction are explicitly called out in the technical analysis as open design decisions, not discoverable in code.

No exact precedent for a category concept that cuts across the existing `domain` column (Budget category spans project_management and budget_management event types), so the category filter cannot reuse the simple SQL IN-on-domain pattern; bumped via the 'requires data migration' red flag (new label column needs an Alembic migration).

New taxonomy module + its reflective completeness test, new/extended response models, migration file, and several new category/disabled-vs-empty/conditional-emission test files, alongside modifications to activity_models.py, activity_repository.py, activity_event_service.py, project_activity_events_router.py, and project_service.py, with possible touches to several of the 10 existing emit-site files for label snapshotting; bumped via the data-migration red flag.
Model/DB-Persistence (new column, migration), Service, and API layers are all touched in a standard path; Settings layer is read for the pre-update flag value.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: new label column requires a data migration (no existing precedent for a readable-label field on ActivityEvent).
File Change Estimate bumped from L to XL: same data-migration red flag, plus the wide but shallow ripple across existing emit sites.
